title: Amazon will share its Q2 2026 earnings on July 30
summary: On July 30, Amazon is set to hold a conference call to discuss its Q2 2026 financial results.
body_markdown:
Amazon will hold a conference call to discuss its Q2 2026 financial results on July 30 at 2:00 p.m. PT/5:00 p.m. ET.


The event will be webcast live, and the audio and associated slides will be available for at least three months thereafter at


[www.amazon.com/ir](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2Fir&esheet=53884885&newsitemid=20240118568335&lan=en-US&anchor=www.amazon.com%2Fir&index=1&md5=4c0e1e90922118b7c8ab82daebca275d) .
